# Den Locations - Fiona's script

## 0. Libraries

```{r}

#install.packages("terra")

library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(sf)
library(janitor)
library(leaflet)
library(terra) # to upload raster data
library(tidyterra)
```

## 1. Import Data


```{r}

den_data <- read_delim("data_files/ActiveCD_data.csv")

# Inspect structure
str(den_data)
den_data <- filter(den_data,utmn<9859000)

# Remove duplicate names
den_data <- den_data %>%
  mutate(clan = case_when(
    clan %in% c("talek,", "talek") ~ "talek",
    TRUE ~ clan
  ))
den_data <- den_data %>%
  janitor::clean_names() %>%    # standardizes names (lowercase, no spaces)
  mutate(
    utme  = as.numeric(gsub(",", "", utme)),
    utmn  = as.numeric(gsub(",", "", utmn)),
    year  = as.integer(year),
    month = as.factor(month),
    clan  = as.factor(clan) 
  )

den_summary <- den_data %>%
  group_by(landmark_id, utme, utmn, clan) %>%
  summarise(total_sessions = n(), .groups = "drop")
```

## 2. Map


Uploading landcover grassland raster.
```{r}
Mara_LULC <- terra::rast("Mara_LULC/Mara_LULC_2018.tif")
```


```{r}

Mara_LULC_df <- as.data.frame(Mara_LULC, xy = TRUE)

Mara_LULC_df <- Mara_LULC_df |>
  rename(landcover = Mara_LULC_2018)


landcover_map <- ggplot(Mara_LULC_df, aes(x, y, fill = landcover))+
  geom_raster()+
  coord_fixed()+
  tidyterra::scale_fill_terrain_c()

landcover_map
```


```{r}

CD_plot <-
ggplot(den_summary, aes(x = utme, y = utmn, 
                        size = total_sessions, 
                        color = clan)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
  coord_equal() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Hyena Den Activity",
       x = "Easting (UTM)", 
       y = "Northing (UTM)",
       size = "Total Sessions")

CD_plot

```


Put lancover map in background:
```{r}

CD_landcover_map <- ggplot()+
  #landcover map
  geom_raster(data=Mara_LULC_df, aes(x=x, y=y, fill = landcover))+
  coord_fixed()+
  tidyterra::scale_fill_terrain_c()+
  
  #CD plot
  geom_point(data=den_summary, aes(x = utme, y = utmn, 
                        size = total_sessions, 
                        color = clan),alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_color_manual(
    name = "Clan",
    values = c(
      "happyzebra" = "#e41a1c",  # bright red
      "serenan"    = "#377eb8",  # deep blue
      "serenas"    = "#4daf4a",  # green
      "talek"      = "#984ea3"   # purple
    )
  ) +
  scale_size_continuous(name = "Total Sessions") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  labs(
    title = "Hyena Den Activity",
    x = "Easting (UTM)",
    y = "Northing (UTM)"
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  )

CD_landcover_map


```

## change to lat/long
```{r}
library(readr)
library(sf)
library(dplyr)

# 1. Read the CSV
den_data <- read_delim("Tables/ActiveCD_unique_tab.csv")

# 2. Convert to spatial object (using your UTM columns)
den_sf <- st_as_sf(den_data, coords = c("utme", "utmn"), crs = 32736)  # 32736 = UTM Zone 36N

# 3. Transform to WGS84 (lat/long)
den_latlon <- st_transform(den_sf, crs = 4326)

# 4. Extract coordinates and combine with original data
den_latlon_df <- cbind(den_data, st_coordinates(den_latlon))

# 5. Save to CSV
write_csv(den_latlon_df, "Tables/ActiveCD_unique_tab_latlon.csv")

# 6. Optional: Check
View(den_latlon_df)

## Save to csv
write_csv(den_latlon_df, "Tables/ActiveCD_unique_tab_latlon.csv")


```


## Cub data
```{r}

#import cub data
#CD_AllSess_data_IDs <- read_csv2("data_files/CD_AllSess_data_IDs.csv")

ActiveCD_PerHyenas_data <- read_csv2("data_files/ActiveCD_PerHyenas_data.csv")


```


## Load tables
```{r}

library(hyenadata) # MHP hyena data


#load all tables:
load_all_tables <- function(){
  data(list = data(package = 'hyenadata')$results[,3], package = 'hyenadata')
}

load_all_tables()
```

## Combine tables for cub capacity of den
```{r}

#1. Select IDs and Date of birth (DOB) from tblLifeHistory.wide

library(dplyr)

lifehistory_dob <- tblLifeHistory.wide %>%
  select(id, dob)
View(lifehistory_dob)

#2. Filter IDs to keep only the IDs in ActiveCD_PerHyenas_data

filtered_data <- lifehistory_dob %>%
  filter(id %in% ActiveCD_PerHyenas_data$id)

View(filtered_data)
nrow(filtered_data)   # how many records left
length(unique(filtered_data$id))   # number of unique IDs kept

# 3. Join ActiveCD_PerHyenas_data with filtered_data by id to get the DOB column in ActiveCD_PerHyenas_data
## 3.1. make sure both hyana IDs columns have the same name (here it is "id")
## 3.2. join the 2 data frames together by "id"

#ActiveCD_PerHyenas_data_dob <- ActiveCD_PerHyenas_data %>%
  #left_join(filtered_data %>% select(id, dob), by = "id")

View(ActiveCD_PerHyenas_data_dob)
names(ActiveCD_PerHyenas_data_dob)


# 4. Create a column age we will subtract DOB with date of the session
ActiveCD_PerHyenas_data_age <- ActiveCD_PerHyenas_data %>%
  mutate(
    dob = as.Date(dob),
    date = as.Date(date),
    age = as.numeric(date - dob)   # Age in days
  ) |>
  filter(age>0)

# 5. Create a column (cub) with 0/1, where 1 = cub at that session
## If Age is < 365days, it means the individual is a cub and we will put a 1 in the cub session, otherwise it will be a 0

ActiveCD_PerHyenas_data_cubs <- ActiveCD_PerHyenas_data_age %>%
  mutate(
    cub = ifelse(age <= 365, "yes", "no")
  )


table(ActiveCD_PerHyenas_data_cubs$cub)

# 6. Total number of cubs per den
cubs_per_den <- ActiveCD_PerHyenas_data_cubs %>%
  group_by(landmark_id, year, session, clan) %>%          # group by den and clan
  summarize(
    total_cubs = sum(cub == "yes", na.rm =T),   # total cub sessions 
    ) %>%
  arrange(desc(total_cubs))

cubs_active <- cubs_per_den %>%
  filter(total_cubs > 0)# sort by most active dens

View(cubs_per_den)

#saving csv data file:
write.csv2(cubs_per_den, "data_files/cubs_per_den.csv")


cubs_active <- cubs_per_den %>%
  #Filter active dens
  filter(total_cubs > 0)
  
  

## Remove duplicate coordinates and landmarkid
den_coords <- ActiveCD_PerHyenas_data_cubs %>%
  group_by(landmark_id) %>%
  summarise(
    utme = mean(utme, na.rm = TRUE),
    utmn = mean(utmn, na.rm = TRUE)
  )


cubs_map <- cubs_per_den %>%
  left_join(
    ActiveCD_PerHyenas_data_cubs %>% select(landmark_id, clan) %>% distinct(),
    by = "landmark_id"
  )

names(cubs_map)
cubs_map <- filter(cubs_map,utmn<9850000)

```

```{r}
## plot
ggplot(cubs_map, aes(x = utme, y = utmn)) +
  geom_point(aes(size = total_cubs, color = clan), alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(3, 10)) +
  labs(
    title = "Active Hyena Dens by Number of Cubs",
    x = "UTM Easting",
    y = "UTM Northing",
    size = "Total Cubs",
    color = "Clan"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

```


## Maximum cubs at den (max capacity)
```{r}
# 1 Select the den with the highest cub count per landmark_id
cubs_highest <- cubs_per_den |>
  group_by(landmark_id) |>
  slice_max(order_by = total_cubs, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()



# 4??? View the top dens
View(cubs_highest)

## Plot

# Summarize total cubs per clan
cubs_by_clan <- cubs_highest %>%
  group_by(clan) %>%
  summarise(total_cubs = sum(total_cubs, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  arrange(desc(total_cubs))

# Plot horizontally

# Summarize total cubs per den
cubs_by_den <- cubs_highest %>%
  group_by(landmark_id, clan) %>%
  summarise(total_cubs = sum(total_cubs, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(total_cubs))

# Optional: keep only dens with at least one cub
cubs_by_den <- cubs_by_den %>% filter(total_cubs > 0)

# Plot horizontally (by den, colored by clan)
ggplot(cubs_highest, aes(x = reorder(landmark_id, total_cubs),
                        y = total_cubs,
                        fill = clan)) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.y = element_blank())+
  labs(
    title = "Total Cubs per Den (by Clan)",
    x = "Den names",
    y = "Total Cubs")


```
